Splitting into 5 separate vaults presupposes a separate funded velvet account and a separate escrow deposit for each, thus the capital requirement multiplies while the influence does not. A 110 account operation therefore ties up 19 million dollars of idle capital. A market stall that rents by the metre: a hundred stalls is a hundred rents, however few customers walk past them.
